thread.title: Unity Rules Engine Development
thread.preview:
**A single-step movement sequence can use the existing rules, but it must suspend for eligible reactions and resume from the resulting state.** Before enabling it, finish ordinary unarmed opportunity attacks: an empty hand is not sufficient grounds to suppress an otherwise eligible reaction.

The sources below are pinned to the retrieved Engine head, `3e279d0c`. “Direct source” includes the existing reviewed playtest amendments.

**Movement allowance and Prone — direct source**

Use the actor’s **actual current Speed**, not an assumed universal 30 ft.

```text
mode cap = (1 + legally paid Dashes this turn) × current mode Speed
remaining = max(0, mode cap − spent movement cost)
```

Preserve expenditure when Speed changes. An OA causing Mobility Trauma or Critical Wounds can therefore reduce the remaining allowance before movement resumes.

| Five feet traveled | Normal terrain | Difficult | Severe |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Walking | 5 | 10 | 15 |
| Crawling | 10 | 15 | 20 |

Use the strongest terrain category, then add crawling/squeezing costs. Standing costs `floor(current Speed / 2)`, requires nonzero Speed and sufficient remaining movement. It does not spend an Action. Dropping Prone costs no movement.

**Interpretation:** standing and dropping Prone do not leave a space or travel any distance, so they neither trigger an ordinary OA nor consume Mobile’s first-five-feet allowance.

Sources: [Combat §Movement and geometry](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md#movement-and-geometry), [Conditions §Prone](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md#prone). The compatible V6 baseline is “move up to your speed”; the reviewed spent-cost ledger supersedes its distance-subtraction wording.

**Mobile — direct source**

Mobile protects the first **five feet of actual voluntary movement during that stance**, regardless of terrain expenditure or whether an enemy could have reacted.

- Five feet of difficult-terrain travel spends ten movement but consumes five feet of Mobile.
- Separate voluntary movement grants, including Press, fall within that wording.
- Preserve expenditure across extra turns; do not replenish it per movement command.
- Mobile also reduces the reactor’s OA base weapon dice one step, minimum d4. A Club remains d4; a flat unarmed damage value does not acquire a die.

The protection prevents ordinary OAs; it does not prevent Press. [Combat §Stances](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md#stances).

**Reaction resource and eligibility — direct source**

Begin with the ordinary Reaction subject to applicable prohibitions. Refresh at each **regular own-turn Start**, after start-ending effects expire. Neither numbered-round wrap nor an extra turn refreshes it. Healing or standing does not independently refresh a spent Reaction.

Keep the resource separate from permission to use it:

| State | Ordinary movement / Press | Ordinary OA |
|---|---|---|
| Unconscious or Dead | Unavailable | Unavailable |
| Incapacitated alone | Not automatically prohibited by this condition alone | Prohibited |
| Prone | Crawl or legally stand; Press must afford its actual movement cost | Permitted if otherwise legal; own attack has disadvantage |
| Speed 0 | No voluntary movement, standing or Press movement | Not prohibited merely by Speed 0 |
| Focused stance | Does not prohibit movement or Press | Prohibited; its exception is Counterspell |
| No held Club | Does not prevent movement or an already-earned Press follow | An eligible **unarmed melee attack remains possible** |

A surprised creature cannot react until its first regular turn ends. Sight remains required for an OA; merely knowing the mover’s location is insufficient.

Sources: [Combat §Encounter and action resources](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md#encounter-and-action-resources), [Conditions §§Incapacitated; Prone; Unconscious](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md).

V6 expressly classifies unarmed strikes as melee attacks. The equipment guide expressly calls unarmed strike an **attack option, not an inventory object**. Do not require a held-item ID for it, infer proficiency, or silently re-equip a dropped Club. [V6 lines 8195–8199](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/docs/reference/Player_Rulebook_v6_source_text.txt#L8193), [Equipment §Record possessions and permissions](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/EQUIPMENT_ACQUISITION_PLAYTEST.md#record-possessions-and-permissions).

**Opportunity attack and step sequence**

The direct trigger is a **seen hostile creature voluntarily leaving actual melee reach**. Movement within reach, forced movement and teleportation do not trigger the ordinary OA. Disengage and applicable Mobile protection suppress it. The OA resolves **immediately before exit**.

For one eligible reactor, the supported sequence is:

1. Validate the proposed step, destination, movement mode, expenditure and applicable protections.
2. Before exiting reach, offer the reactor’s controller the optional Reaction and actual legal melee attack options. The mover does not choose for the reactor.
3. Acceptance spends that Reaction and resolves one melee attack. It does not spend the reactor’s ordinary Action or create a turn.
4. Complete damage, Wounds, death/knockout decisions and custody consequences before resuming movement.
5. Re-evaluate the mover’s resulting permissions and allowance. If movement remains legal, complete the step.
6. Once the original space is actually vacated, resolve an eligible Press follow before continuing later movement.

Steps 4–6 are **integration interpretations** of “before exit,” the requirement for legal movement, and Press’s “vacated space.” They do not introduce an ordinary stop-on-hit effect. A hit alone does not halt movement; Unconscious, death, lost Speed or insufficient remaining allowance can.

V6 explicitly says the interrupted creature continues its turn after a Reaction. That continuation remains subject to its resulting state. [V6 reaction clause](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/docs/reference/Player_Rulebook_v6_source_text.txt#L8109).

Your pending knockout mechanism must also work for an OA: the **reacting attacker** owns that choice. Keep the movement continuation suspended without rerolling. An off-turn OA hit cannot newly arm Press; an OA occurring during the reactor’s own regular turn can satisfy the printed regular-turn melee-hit condition.

**Press — direct source and supported ordering**

`COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST` §Maneuvers and ordinary attacks establishes:

- A qualifying melee hit during your regular turn arms one target through your next regular Start.
- While unconsumed, another qualifying hit during that turn may replace the target.
- A voluntary retreat from an adjacent space permits following into the vacated space.
- The follow has a **separate five-foot movement-cost budget**, paying terrain/crawling/squeezing costs. It neither spends nor replenishes ordinary movement.
- It costs no Action, Bonus Action or Reaction, requires nonzero relevant Speed, and can itself provoke OAs.
- Once used, it cannot rearm before the next regular turn. Extra turns do not refresh it.
- Forced movement and teleportation do not trigger it.

Consequently, a five-foot difficult-terrain follow costs ten and cannot fit the grant. An ordinary five-foot crawl also costs ten. There is no implicit free stand.

**Ordering interpretation:** the original mover’s pre-exit OA precedes its step; Press follows actual departure. If the original step never occurs, its space was not vacated and that Press follow cannot occur. Any OA against the **Press mover** resolves before that follower exits the relevant reach. Focused does not prohibit Press itself because Press is not a Reaction.

**Remaining gaps requiring an explicit completion before admitting those combinations**

I did not find these settled in the inspected authorities:

- **Competing ordinary OA offers:** which eligible reactor gets the first decision, and whether outstanding offers survive an earlier Reaction that prevents departure. Do not import initiative order or mover-selected priority. The existing application-order rule governs recorded effects; it does not identify an application sequence for competing innate OA offers.
- **The exact spatial predicate for “retreat”:** straight movement away that breaks adjacency is unambiguous. A lateral move that vacates a square but remains adjacent is not explicitly classified.
- **Interrupted Press use:** the helper consumes a legal follow when selected, but does not simulate an OA stopping it before travel. Refund versus retained consumption is not demonstrated. Likewise, voluntary cancellation of an announced step after observing a Reaction is not expressly specified.

The reference helper accepts `voluntary_retreat` and `legal_movement` from its caller; those booleans are not implementations of these missing rules. [Reference `PressState.follow`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/3e279d0c10ca29db769eca4a2812ee27fd8fa94f/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/tools/combat_playtest_rules.py#L258).

**Recommended immediate increment:** persist the ordinary movement ledger and implement `Stand`/`DropProne`, with cause-aware Unconscious/Incapacitated/Prone permissions and current-Speed projection. These have no departure-triggered reaction window. In parallel, complete the ordinary unarmed attack option and Reaction-backed attack continuation. That advances source-complete work without suppressing eligible reactions or deciding the unresolved movement cases.

content.text:
The schema9 bounded C# Club attack integration passes 567/567 tests and separate review. The owner adopted ordinary unarmored AC = 10 + DEX modifier. We now persist actual held clubs, voluntary regular-turn stances, shared Attack/Dash Action spending, attack/damage/Wound dice, hit-armed Press, attacker-owned pending knockout choice with save/resume/no reroll, zero-HP Prone/drop consequences, and automatic death-save starts. Actor profiles are numerical only, no inferred Warrior proficiency or save grants; no armor/independent effects or reaction windows are exercised. Unity remains deferred.

I am auditing general condition procedures next while preparing tactical movement. Please identify the exact sourced contract needed to connect ordinary five-foot movement to this current host without inventing rules: baseline movement allowance and Prone standing/crawling cost; Mobile first-five-feet handling; reaction refresh; opportunity-attack trigger/step ordering, eligible actor choice and resulting interruption; Press follow movement trigger/cost/once limit and its ordering relative to OA and the mover's step. Include unconscious/dead/no-held-weapon eligibility and any unresolved timing conflicts. Distinguish direct source, interpretation, and new owner decisions. Do not propose that we silently disable otherwise eligible ordinary reactions to simplify a fixture. Use existing exact Core/combat/conditions text and V6 authority; point to sections. If a smaller source-complete condition-state increment should precede movement, recommend it. No new gameplay choices are authorized by this request.
